title: RTK-1 Base Re-Sync and Calibration Tarp Integrity Check — Birch Hollow Range

fields.organization: Harwick UAS Operations Group — Flight Operations
fields.location: Lakeshore Flight Area, RTK-1 base station (SM-L1), lodge parking pad (TP-LFA-LP1)
fields.weather: Clear, 72°F, wind 6 mph from the west
fields.summary: This is the Site Manager at Birch Hollow Range. RTK-1 base (SM-L1) has been re-checked. GPS fix restored. RTK sync confirmed. The calibration tarps (CT-1 to CT-4) were not disturbed. The Payload Operator has just called 'PANEL CLEAR' again. All pre-flight checks are now green. The telemetry pipeline may be re-enabled under supervision.

findings.notes: Confirmed via GCS-03 status page; full fix restored at 12:23:44
Sync status: 'RTK Synced' on GCS-03; confirmed via HUOG-NAS01 log
All tarps present and undisturbed; no signs of disturbance or movement
RP-1 upright and unobstructed; visible from GCS-03 HMI
Confirmed: Payload Operator said 'PANEL CLEAR' at 12:24:11; recorded in GCS-03 telemetry log
All site markers and cones in place; no unauthorized personnel or equipment on site
No guest activity detected; all zones clear
915 MHz link quality: 78%; no spikes or anomalies
In manual/attitude mode on meadow; battery 82%; no further movement
Secured in Faraday bag; no further emissions detected

actionsTaken: Re-verified RTK-1 base (SM-L1) GPS and RTK sync via GCS-03
Confirmed calibration tarps (CT-1–CT-4) were not disturbed
Re-confirmed Payload Operator's 'PANEL CLEAR' call at 12:24:11
Notified Incident Commander and Technical Lead of system readiness for telemetry re-enablement under supervision
recommendations: Re-enable telemetry pipeline under HUOG-ERP Section 11.3 supervision
Conduct full pre-flight verification before any new flight campaign
Maintain RTK-1 base (SM-L1) under continuous surveillance until full forensic clearance
fields.photosNote: 2 photos attached: IMG_0120-0121 (RTK-1 base, SM-L1); IMG_0122-0123 (calibration tarps, CT-1 to CT-4)

instructorNote: This inject confirms restoration of RTK-1 and tarp integrity. The team must now re-enable telemetry under supervision. Watch for premature attempts to re-activate automation.
